_comment: SHAPE ONLY - do NOT paste this file. Run setup_mcp.py --install (Windows: python, macOS/Linux: python3). It writes the real absolute paths into ~/.workbuddy-ai/mcp.json, into ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json when that folder exists, and into mcp.local.json. No key, no env, no headers.
_note_macos_linux: On macOS/Linux setup generates ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_THIS_REPO/.venv/bin/python instead of .venv/Scripts/python.exe. macOS needs Python 3.10+ (Xcode's python3 is 3.9): install from python.org or `brew install python@3.12`.
